image_description: A grand, ornate pipe organ situated within a wooden architectural niche or alcove. The instrument features a symmetrical arrangement of vertical metal pipes of varying heights and diameters, creating a stepped silhouette. The central section contains taller, larger-diameter pipes, flanked by shorter, thinner pipes. The casing is elaborately carved wood with classical motifs, columns, and decorative moldings, illuminated by warm, reddish lighting. Two individuals are seated at the console in the foreground, facing away from the camera, operating the keyboards. The console appears to have multiple manuals (keyboards) and stop controls, though details are partially obscured by the players and low light.
